scientific_question: Can one fixed-physical-q/p four-dimensional common-track update explain the remaining actual strip residuals?
fit_definition: one SVD least-squares update using full-step H, exact diagonal strip sigma_sq, no prior, no damping, no iteration
success: all six events pass nominal repeat, all arms finite/on bounded surface, four FD columns stable, full rank, update cap, actual replay/linear prediction agreement, and actual cost ratio <=0.5
failure_unknown: null/out-of-bounds propagation or failed FD/rank/cap means UNKNOWN for a physical nuisance conclusion; valid replay failing cost or linearization criterion means FAIL for this one-step hypothesis, not falsification of all possible tracks
